tha-ap159:1.1: Tiṇasūlaka.] Himavantass' avidūre Bhūtagaṇo nāma pabbato / vasat' eko jino tattha sayambhū lokanissaṭo. // //
tha-ap159:2.1: Tiṇasūle gahetvāna Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ / ekūnasatasahassaṃ kappānaṃ 'vinipātako. // //
tha-ap159:3.1: Ito ekādase kappe eko 'si Dharaṇīruho / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap159:5.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Tiṇasulako thero i. g. ā-ti. Tiṇasūlakattherassa
